usedFor: Shopify holds paid orders, and Template To builds the document when “Order Paid” runs “Create PDF From Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create PDF From Template” in Template To
bestTemplate.why: A paid order produces a PDF from your template, and the action returns the file URL.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” fires on changes, so one order can produce another PDF.
